problem_statement.value:
[R524-BATTERY declared_family=thermal source=odi:11400072 battery=R524-CURRENT-PRODUCTION-ATTRIBUTION-current]

I PURCHASED THE 2020 KIA FORTE LAST APRIL 2020. THE TRUNK LATCH WOULD NOT OPEN TRUNK, REPORTED, SERVICED IT STILL PRESENTED TIGHT LEVERAGE FUNCTION DURING STABLE PARK POSITION. THE COMPUTER SCRAMBLED THE 1ST OR 2ND WEEK OF OWNING IT DURING MY EARLY MORNING HIGHWAY TRAVEL THE COMPUTER SCRAMBLED MORE THAN ONCE. I CONTACTED KIA- THIER RESPONSE WAS NOT HELPFUL TO THE NEW CAR MALFUNCTION. IT HAPPENED MORE THAN ONCE. THE LANE DEPARTURE DID NOT WORK AT DIFERENT PERIODS IN TIME; WITHIN THE YEAR I REPORTED TO KIA. THE WINDSHIELD CRACKED DURING FIRST FROST. KIA CLAIMED ROCK CHIP. I HAD JUST SERVICED CABIN FILTER AREA, KIA RELENTLESSLY ASSUMED ROCK CHIP, I BELIEVE DEFECTED GLASS. THE FIRST FROST IT CRACKED 2ND FROST WITHIN 2WEEK TIME OR LESS SPLIT CRACK ACROSS WINDSHIELD. THE GAS AND MILAGE WERE NOT STABLLY OPERATING WAS OUT OF SYNC DURING HIGHWAY TRAVELS. I NOW FOR THE LAST WEEK NOTICED A NOISE IN MY CAR ENGINE WHEN IN PARK TURNING IT OFF. I AM UNHAPPY WITH MY PURCHASE AND THE KIA DEALERSHIP I PURCHASED IT FROM. I HAVE PICTURES OF REPORTED DASH COMPUTER MALFUNCTIONS, AND AN UNWILLING DEALERSHIP TO ASSIST WITH MY VEHICLE. I AM CONCERNED WITH MY SAFETY, MY PASSENGERS SAFETY, AND SAFETY IN MY FUTURE DRIVE.  I PUT DATE OF APRIL 20, 2020 BECAUSE IT WAS ROUGHLY WHEN MALFUNCTIONS BEGAN TO OCCURE. THE TRUNK LATCH IMMEDIATELY 4/10/2020 OR AT PURCHASE DATE UPON ARRIVING HOME.

observed_failure.basis: failure noun phrase found verbatim in the user's message

value: Solution must address the stated objective without introducing a larger failure mode
constraints.basis: default engineering constraint applied when the user stated none (the engine's standing problem contract)

context.basis: deterministic surface features of the message

domain_hypothesis.basis: keyword score 3 (hits: vehicle, engine, car); full ranking recorded in domain_scores

physical_system.basis: system noun phrase matched in the user's message

target_variable.basis: quantity word matched in the message (outcome-object phrases included as fallback candidates)

assumptions.assumption: the message describes ONE engineering problem
assumptions.falsified_by: a second unrelated objective in the text

success_condition.basis: cannot be composed — outcome or target unknown

failure_condition.value: the mechanism does not materially change the target variable, introduces a larger failure mode, or is contradicted by admissible evidence
failure_condition.basis: the engine's standing falsification contract (Art. XX/LII)
